v1_vs_v2_comparison.key_finding: Map coordinates completely eliminated the Stage 5.2 candidate generation failure for all 5 cases where coordinates existed. In V1, textual bairro absence from the corpus caused 100% retrieval failure (0 candidates). In V2, coordinates allowed spatial proximity anchoring to retrieve real cadastral candidates in nearby sectors of Taubate.

root_cause_analysis: The candidate corpus (acervo_casas_taubate.json) contains exactly 3,002 parcels restricted to 31 specific bairros in Taubate.
Taubate has more than 100 bairros and over 100,000 parcels in its full municipal cadastre.

The 10 real-world listings scraped from Chaves na Mao were randomly drawn across Taubate: 9 of the 10 listings (90%) are located in bairros that have 0 parcels in acervo_casas_taubate.json (Jardim Continental III, Jardim Oasis, Jardim Gurilandia, Jardim Eulalia, Campos Eliseos, Vila Santa Isabel, Jardim Santa Tereza).
Only 1 listing (38732282, Jardim Mourisco) was located in a bairro represented in the candidate corpus (48 parcels in sector 5.2).

Because 90% of the ground truth properties are physically not present in the candidate corpus (NOT_PRESENT_IN_CORPUS), no address matching algorithm could achieve Top-1 or Top-20 hits on the full municipal cohort without expanding corpus coverage.

stage_breakdown.stage_1_discovery: Scraped 10 active real-world listings. Selection did not filter by corpus coverage, exposing the out-of-corpus distribution gap.
stage_breakdown.stage_3_public_inputs: Successfully extracted public clues, but revealed that public ads frequently withhold house numbers and exact streets.
stage_breakdown.stage_5_2_candidate_retrieval_v1: Failed for 9/10 listings due to missing bairro in candidate corpus.
stage_breakdown.stage_5_2_candidate_retrieval_v2: Succeeded in generating candidate sets for 6/10 listings (60%) via spatial coordinate anchoring, demonstrating strong retrieval capability even under missing text bairro, but hit the ceiling of out-of-corpus ground truth.

counterfactual_1_full_municipal_cadastre.description: If the candidate corpus contained all ~100,000 Taubate municipal parcels rather than a sample of 3,002 parcels:
counterfactual_1_full_municipal_cadastre.projected_v1_candidate_generation: 100% (10/10 listings would have matching bairros and streets in corpus)
counterfactual_1_full_municipal_cadastre.projected_v2_spatial_accuracy: High: coordinate pinpoints in V2 (error radius 50m-200m) would directly constrain candidates to the exact street and adjacent quadras, yielding Top-20 recall estimated at 70-90%.

counterfactual_2_in_corpus_sampling.description: If the pilot cohort had been restricted to listings in bairros already present in acervo_casas_taubate.json (such as Jardim das Nacoes, Vila Marli, Bosque Flamboyant):
counterfactual_2_in_corpus_sampling.projected_effect: Would test model discrimination rather than corpus boundary truncation.

pre_registered_benchmark_assessment.actionable_recommendation: The Address Finder architecture demonstrates functional spatial retrieval (V2 boosted candidate generation from 10% to 60%), but cannot proceed to production or high Top-k accuracy without ingesting the complete Taubate municipal cadastre (full coverage of all sectors and bairros) into the candidate corpus.
